# {{ site.name }}

> {{ site.title }} at the Institute of Sociology, {{ site.institution }} (Kraków, Poland). Sociologist working in Science and Technology Studies (STS): sociotechnical imaginaries, energy transitions and decarbonisation, maritime futures (Sea Societies, Baltic Sea), and public health controversies. Leads the Capturing Invisible LAB and co-organises the CI LAB Seminars series.

Full name: Tadeusz Józef Rudek. Contact: {{ site.email }}. Research fellowships at Harvard University, King's College London and ETH Zurich. Projects include FAMOS (floating archipelagos, blue economy), PANTHEON (Horizon Europe, EU–China decarbonisation pathways), VAX-TRUST and NEEDS Repowered.
